title: MatchaGoose
summary: A dating/matching web app (signup, onboarding, swiping, liking, matching, profile management) built with a TypeScript frontend and Python backend. Its production-data seeding script uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate a realistic synthetic Users table for testing since real production data is unavailable.
evidence: sql/generate_production_data.py:4-5,52 imports CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata from sdv, then calls CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, ...) to generate mock users
